root_cause: The approved Dutch blog introduced 68 new public strings while production validation requires complete pre-approved English cache coverage for every sitemap-visible route.
prevention_rule: Before an approved central blog candidate is eligible for merge, all newly introduced translatable public strings must have a deterministic English cache patch; never publish NL-only content into the bilingual route set.
evidence: Required Test for approved blog candidate reported STATIC_I18N_CACHE_INCOMPLETE with exactly 68 missing strings on 2026-10-02.
